newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco says on track with $250 mln goal.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco says on track with $250 mln goal.

text.p: Sonoco said Wednesday it is on track with its objective of realizing $250 million in earnings by the end of the year 2000.
The company said it has begun to see some of the positive effects of the growth and cost-reduction initiatives that were implemented in 1996.
The company said it believes the solid performance of most of the businesses during the first quarter will continue throughout the year.

The company also said its first quarter performance was in line with its previously stated expectation that earnings for the first two quarters of 1997 would be flat to slkightly down, compared with 1996, and then improve in the second half.
